description_en: Queries the information about an instance
description_zh: 调用GetInstance接口，获取实例的详细信息
name: GetInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173982.html operation to query the ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The environment of the workspace. Valid values: PROD and DEV
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

BeginRunningTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to run
BeginRunningTime.description_zh:
实例开始运行的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

BeginWaitResTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to wait for resources
BeginWaitResTime.description_zh:
实例开始等待资源的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

BeginWaitTimeTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to wait to be scheduled
BeginWaitTimeTime.description_zh:
实例开始等待调度的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

Bizdate.description_en: The data timestamp of the instance. In most cases, the value is one day before the time when the instance was run
Bizdate.description_zh:
业务日期。通常为该任务运行时间的前一天。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590336000000`

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was generated
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例的创建时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

CycTime.description_en: The scheduling time of the instance
CycTime.description_zh:
实例的定时时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590422400000`

DagType.description_en:
The type of the workflow. Valid values:

DAILY: The workflow is used to run auto triggered nodes.
MANUAL: The workflow is used to run manually triggered nodes.
SMOKE_TEST: The workflow is used to perform smoke testing.
SUPPLY_DATA: The workflow is used to backfill data
DagType.description_zh:
工作流的类型，取值如下：

DAILY(0)：日常调度工作流
MANUAL(1)：手动任务工作流
SMOKE_TEST(2)：冒烟测试工作流
SUPPLY_DATA(3)：补数据工作流
MANUAL_FLOW(4)：手动运行的dataflow pai 业务流程等（如IDE上点击运行业务流程）
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG(5)：手动业务流程工作流

DqcDescription.description_en: The table and partition filter expression in Data Quality that are associated with the node

DqcType.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality. Valid values:

0: The instance is associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality.
1: The instance is not associated with a monitoring rule in Data Quality
DqcType.description_zh:
数据质量DQC类型，取值如下：
0表示有关联dqc。
1表示没有关联dqc

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the running of the instance was complete
FinishTime.description_zh:
实例运行的结束时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the instance was last modified
ModifyTime.description_zh:
实例的最新修改时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1590416703313`

ParamValues.description_en: The parameters related to the node
ParamValues.example: bizdate=$bizdate tbods=$tbods tbdw=$tbdw tbpmic=$tbpmic tbpidx=$tbpidx tbptcif=$tbptcif

PeriodNumber.description_en: The sequence number of the cycle. This parameter indicates the sequence number of the cycle of the instance on the current day
PeriodNumber.description_zh: 周期序号。表示任务实例处于当天的第几轮周期

Priority.description_en: The priority of the instance. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8. A greater value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1
Priority.description_zh: 实例运行优先级，取值分为1、3、5、7和8。取值越大，优先级越高。默认优先级为1

RelatedFlowId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the node belongs

RepeatInterval.description_en: The interval at which the node is rerun after the node fails to run. Unit: milliseconds
RepeatInterval.description_zh: 调度任务运行出错后，重新调整调度频率，单位为毫秒（ms）

Repeatability.description_en: Indicates whether the node that generates the instance can be rerun
Repeatability.description_zh: 实例是否可以重复执行

Status.description_en:
The status of the node that generates the instance. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The node is not run.
WAIT_TIME: The node is waiting for its scheduling time to arrive.
WAIT_RESOURCE: The node is waiting for resources.
RUNNING: The node is running.
CHECKING: Data quality is being checked for the node.
CHECKING_CONDITION: Branch conditions are being checked for the node.
FAILURE: The node fails to run.
SUCCESS: The node is successfully run
Status.description_zh:
任务的状态，取值如下：

NOT_RUN(1)：未运行
WAIT_TIME(2)： 等待时间。等待定时时间到来
WAIT_RESOURCE(3)：等待资源。已经下发到执行引擎，在等待资源排队调度执行
RUNNING(4)：运行中
CHECKING(7)：校验中。执行完毕，下发给数据质量进行数据校检
CHECKING_CONDITION(8)： 条件检测中。执行完毕，正在做分支条件校验
WAIT_TRIGGER(9)：等待触发。触发式节点会在等待时间后变成等待触发
FAILURE(5)：运行失败
SUCCESS(6)：运行成功

TaskRerunTime.description_en:
The number of times the node can be rerun. The value of this parameter can be empty or an integer that is greater than or equal to 0.

If the value of this parameter is empty, the number of times that the node can be rerun is not specified.
If the value of this parameter is 0, the node cannot be rerun.
If the value of this parameter is a positive integer such as n, the node can still be rerun n times. For example, if the value of this parameter is 1, the node can still be rerun once. If the value of this parameter is 2, the node can still be rerun twice
TaskRerunTime.description_zh:
实例还可以运行的次数。取值可以为空、以及大于等于0的整数。
取值为空，表示该实例对应的节点没有设置自动重跑次数。
取值为0，表示该实例不能再重跑。
取值为大于0的整数（假设为n），表示该实例可重跑次数为n。例如，该参数取值为1，则剩余重跑次数为1，取值为2，则剩余重跑次数为2，以此类推。初始值为对应节点定义的自动重跑次数+1

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the node that generates the instance. Valid values:

NORMAL(0): The node is an auto triggered node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node.
MANUAL(1): The node is a manually triggered node. The scheduling system does not regularly run the node.
PAUSE(2): The node is a frozen node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to failed when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP(3): The node is a dry-run node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): The node is an unselected node in a temporary workflow. This type of node exists only in temporary workflows. The scheduling system sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): The node is a node that is scheduled by the week or month and is waiting for the scheduling time to arrive. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): The node is not selected by its ancestor branch node and is run as a dry-run node.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): The node has instances that are generated in real time but deprecated. The scheduling system sets the status of the node to successful
TaskType.description_zh:
实例的调度类型，取值如下：
NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：冻结任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the instance fails to be scheduled
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调度实例失败时的异常信息

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
